about.zh: 专注 AI Agent 与大模型技术。从模型训练、微调到推理部署，再到智能体工程，我关心的是这条链路能不能真正跑通——而不只是跑出一个能演示的 Demo。
about.en: Focused on AI agents and large language models. From training and fine-tuning to inference deployment and agent engineering, what matters to me is whether the whole chain actually runs — not whether a demo looks impressive.

doing.zh: 让 Agent 真正完成任务
doing.desc_zh: 多步规划、工具调用、自我反思——把一次问答变成一段能收敛的执行过程。
doing.desc_en: Multi-step planning, tool calls and self-reflection — turning a single answer into a process that converges.

doing.desc_zh: 用微调和量化，把通用模型调整到能解决具体问题的状态。
doing.desc_en: Fine-tuning and quantization to move a general model into a state that solves a specific problem.

doing.desc_zh: 推理加速与服务化部署，从「能跑」到「跑得起、跑得稳」。
doing.desc_en: Inference acceleration and service deployment — from 'it runs' to 'it runs reliably at a cost you can afford'.
